description: Active voucher of the store, started, not expired, with balance left, restricted to one customer, created for a user the test created (VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER only finds existing users' vouchers). Deleted at teardown. KB: Managing Vouchers. Story Z10-28590.

store.description: Store code the voucher belongs to (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

now.description: System param: evaluation time, filled in by the profiler or resolver; tests do not set it

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId the voucher is restricted to: link it to a user of the test (@assigned.userId). Left out (verification only): any customer
